source_contents.e1:
the Eagles routed the Chiefs 40-22 on Sunday to secure the franchise's second Super Bowl championship.
the Philadelphia Eagles' ferocious defense denied Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce and the Kansas City Chiefs a Super Bowl three-peat
source_contents.e2:
The underdog Eagles defeated the Patriots with a score of 41–33 to win their first Super Bowl and their first NFL title since 1960.
February 4, 2018
